assertions.subject: brief psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: the psychotic symptoms occur exclusively during a full major depressive, manic, or mixed episode

assertions.subject: brief psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: the diagnosis of brief psychotic disorder cannot be made if the psychotic symptoms are better explained by a mood episode

assertions.subject: schizophreniform disorder
assertions.quote: If the psychotic symptoms persist for 1 month or longer, the diagnosis is either schizophreniform disorder

assertions.subject: brief psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: The differential diagnosis between brief psychotic disorder and schizophreniform disorder is difficult when the psychotic symptoms have remitted be- fore 1 month

assertions.subject: factitious disorder
assertions.quote: An episode of factitious disorder, with predominantly psychological signs and symptoms, may have the appearance of brief psychotic disorder

assertions.subject: malingering
assertions.quote: When malingering involves apparently psychotic symptoms, there is usually evidence that the illness is being feigned for an understandable goal

assertions.subject: personality disorders
assertions.quote: If psychotic symptoms persist for at least 1 day, an additional diagnosis of brief psychotic disorder may be appropriate
